product.name: Monoprice Blackbird 4K60 Video Switcher with HDMI plus Audio Extraction Supports HDR HDCP 2.2 YCbCr 444
product.description: This Blackbird™ 4K 4x1 HDMI® Switch allows you to connect up to four HDMI source devices to a single HDMI display. It supports video resolutions up to 4K@60Hz, including 1080p@60Hz and all 3D video modes. It can extract audio from the HDMI source to the combined 3.5mm analog stereo/mini Toslink® digital optical jack on the rear panel.
